changelog: Paraphrased C1 to be shorter and clearer about contradiction/cancellation risk (addresses the primary finding).
Paraphrased C5 to compress guidance about postnominal material while keeping its judgment (frees headroom).

Inserted new principle asking whether the remainder supplies an argument, complement, negation/exception, or scope-resolving token that completes or reverses the left fragment (directly addresses primary_finding).
Inserted new principle preferring cuts that keep numerals/measures and essential post‑nominal modifiers attached to their head (addresses the numeral/measure finding).
Paraphrased C1 to be shorter and clearer about contradiction/cancellation risk so there is room for a targeted, surface-check rule addressing the primary finding.

Inserted a new Core Principles unit after C5 that forbids splitting numerals/measures and essential post‑nominal modifiers from their heads except when the remainder is clearly an independent clause, addressing the primary_finding directly with a surface-recognizable condition.

Insert a narrow surface check after C5 that forbids cutting when the remainder begins a clause or token that supplies an argument, complement, negation/exception, or scope (addresses the primary_finding with a concrete, surface-recognizable condition).

Inserted a narrow, surface-recognizable check after C5 that forbids cutting a numeral/quantifier away from its unit or the noun it quantifies, and forbids cutting a head noun/proper name away from an immediately following restrictive post‑nominal modifier — directly addressing the primary finding about numerals/measures and essential modifiers.

Replace E1 with measured example en_us_1116 to teach the model to avoid cuts that leave an underspecified fragment whose truth or referent is completed/reversed by the remainder (addresses primary_finding).
Replace E2 with measured example en_us_936 to exemplify subordinate/clausal openings (e.g. 'Unless ...') that must not be split from their consequents.
Replace E3 with measured example en_us_741 to show numeral+unit (2.2 million km2) cohesion issues so the model keeps measures attached to their heads.
Replace E4 with measured example en_us_140 to reinforce protecting numeric speeds and unit expressions (240 kilometers an hour / 149 miles per hour).
Replace E1 with measured example en_us_1150 to teach keeping date ranges and year spans attached to their heads (addresses primary_finding).
Replace E2 with measured example en_us_1017 to teach protecting 'until <date>' and similar date/unit expressions from being split (addresses primary_finding).
Replace E3 with measured example en_us_419 to teach keeping numerals and their unit context (e.g. '340 million to 500 million') attached (addresses primary_finding).
Replace E4 with measured example en_us_1415 to show century/range expressions (e.g. '10th - 11th centuries') should not be split from their heads (addresses primary_finding).

Replace C4 to require explicitly checking whether the remainder supplies a required complement, argument, negation/exception, or scope that completes or reverses the left fragment; lower such cuts but apply conservatively to very short left fragments (addresses the primary_finding).

Insert a concise, surface-check principle after C5 forbidding cuts between numerals/units and between a head noun/proper name and essential post‑nominal modifiers (restrictive relative, prepositional complement, date/measure/range) to protect cohesion (addresses the primary_finding).
